small_guidance:
- Add larger autotune tiles along OHW (BLOCK_N=256/512 with num_warps=8, num_stages=3/4) and try splitting OC into BLOCK_OC=8 vs 16 to reduce register pressure on the [OC_C, BLOCK_N] accumulator — the current 16×512 tile may spill.
- Swap grid order so program_id(0)=N*OD and program_id(1)=hw_tile, or add a small pid swizzle, to improve L2 reuse of the input slab across adjacent OH*OW tiles within the same (n, od).
- Pre-stage the 81-element weight matrix into registers once (load `w[:, :128]` with mask outside the IC/KD/KH/KW loops) and use `tl.dot` of a [BLOCK_N, K_PAD] x [K_PAD, OC] tile instead of 81 separate FMAs, so the inner loop becomes a single MMA.
large_guidance:
- Rewrite as an explicit im2col-GEMM: tile is [BLOCK_M=output-spatial, BLOCK_N=OC=16 padded to 32, BLOCK_K=27 padded to 32], use `tl.dot` for the 81-reduction, and fuse scale/tanh/bias/sigmoid into the epilogue on the accumulator before store. With OC=16 and K=81 small, a single `tl.dot` per program eliminates the 81 unrolled loads.
- Switch input layout to NDHWC (channels-last) once at forward entry so the K dimension (IC*KD*KH*KW) is contiguous; load a [BLOCK_M, 27] tile per kd,kh with a single vectorized gather across IC*KW.
- Consider a persistent kernel that iterates over (n, od) tiles inside one program to amortize weight loads; OD=14 and N=128 give 1792 (n,od) pairs which can be partitioned across SMs with weights resident in registers/SMEM.
